off_pitch.family_situation: Son of Ugandan musician Moses Ssali ('Bebe Cool'); grandson of Jaberi Bidandi Ssali, a founding member of KCCA FC in 1963. Named in homage to Thierry Henry.
off_pitch.commercial_profile: High public profile in Uganda due to his father's fame as a musician; his move to KCCA FC was widely covered as a 'sentimental transfer' given his family's ties to the club's founding.
